messages:
maria: heads up — after the quantization run for `gptx-small` our eval harness started showing ~3% perplexity regression vs HF baseline. dug in and found tokenization mismatches in dev logs. fast tokenizer loads fine but special tokens are different when the runtime picks the slow loader.

aj: can you paste the error / snippet? sounds like the classic fast vs slow mismatch but that perf delta is annoying.

maria: pasted logs below — noticed `tokenizer.json` exists in S3 but `tokenizer_config.json` and `special_tokens_map.json` arrive a few seconds later during model-onboard. runtime sometimes instantiates the fast tokenizer and never reconciles with the slow files. log:

```
2026-03-03T14:21:03Z loader: fetched tokenizer.json (size 2.1MB)
2026-03-03T14:21:04Z tokenizer: fast tokenizer loaded (tokenizer.json)
2026-03-03T14:21:06Z loader: fetched tokenizer_config.json
2026-03-03T14:21:06Z loader: fetched special_tokens_map.json
2026-03-03T14:21:06Z eval: tokenization mismatch detected: unk tokens/indices differ
```

sri: that timing smells like an async-upload/atomicity problem from the conversion job. conversion writes files one-by-one to S3; if runtime loads as soon as it sees `tokenizer.json` you can get a half-baked tokenizer. S3 eventual consistency + multipart uploads can make this flaky.

aj: yep — we saw something similar with vocab merges last year. two options: (1) change converter to upload a single tarball and atomically rename after all files present, or (2) make the loader attempt a validation pass when it sees `tokenizer.json` and wait for required companion files (with a short backoff) before instantiating. the latter reduces churn on the uploader.

felix: +1 for loader-side defensive logic. quick proposal: when loader sees tokenizer.json, run a cheap sanity check: ensure `special_tokens_map.json` exists and that `tokenizer_config.json` contains expected keys (`do_lower_case` / `unk_token` entries). if any missing, sleep 200ms x 5 and retry. If still missing, fallback to building a safe tokenizer from `tokenizer_config.json` if present, or reject the model load with a clear error.

maria: i tried a local repro by uploading files in the bad order and spinning up a dev runtime — repro command below:

```
# split upload order
aws s3 cp tokenizer.json s3://redwood-models/gptx-small/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
sleep 4
aws s3 cp tokenizer_config.json s3://redwood-models/gptx-small/
aws s3 cp special_tokens_map.json s3://redwood-models/gptx-small/
# start runtime that streams model artifacts when index exists
./dev/runtime --model-path s3://redwood-models/gptx-small --autofetch
```

aj: can you attach the minimal repro script so infra can run it in CI? i'd add a test that simulates partial upload and asserts loader waits or fails gracefully.

sri: also a thought — conversion script should produce a `tokenizer_manifest.json` that lists all expected artifacts with checksums. loader can fetch the manifest first and verify complete set before instantiating. that avoids guessing by filenames.

felix: small runtime hotfix i tested locally: if fast tokenizer is loaded but special tokens missing, we reconstruct `special_tokens_map` from `tokenizer_config.json.added_tokens` and `vocab` heuristics then rehydrate fast tokenizer indices. not perfect but it prevented the eval regression in my test. patch:

```
# pseudocode
if fast_loaded and not special_tokens_map:
    if tokenizer_config.present:
        added = tokenizer_config.get('added_tokens', [])
        merge_added_into_fast(added)
        log.warn('reconstructed special tokens from tokenizer_config')
    else:
        raise TokenizerLoadError('incomplete tokenizer artifact set')
```

maria: that's a pragmatic short-term fix. long term i like sri's manifest idea + uploader atomic rename. converter maintainers: can we change `hf-to-redwood-convert` to write a single `_READY` sentinel object after all files are uploaded? then loader only starts if `_READY` present.

aj: converter PR incoming — will add `_READY` sentinel and a `manifest.json` with checksums. also adding a flag `--atomic-upload` that uploads to a temp prefix and does an S3 rename (copy+delete) at the end for older buckets.

felix: i'll push the loader patch that waits 5 tries with backoff and can reconstruct minimal special_tokens_map. will add a unit test and flag it behind `--strict-token-check` so we can roll gradually.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline `model-onboard` triggered for branch `fix/tokenizer-atomic` — run queued (job 4821).

maria: thanks all — plan: aj will land converter PR, felix lands loader hotfix behind flag, sri will spec manifest format (small JSON schema), then we add CI reproducer and an integration test that uploads artifacts out-of-order. target: ship hotfix to dev cluster this week, converter changes next sprint. i'll open a short retro doc with perf/eval numbers. :thumbsup:

aj: noted — attaching repro script and minimal manifest schema in the PR.

sri: one more note — add an eval check that compares token counts (tokens per example) vs HF baseline for the first 100 prompts after bring-up; if difference > 1% fail the rollout. saved us before.

maria: love that — adding to rollout gating checklist. will monitor the current run and post updates here.
